rationale_one_line: Numbers carry the story. ai-hedge-fund proved the demo, dexter ships the product, yesterday's release proves cadence. Editorial-90s gives the buy-side memo a magazine spread, RECEIPT lets the metrics land.
writing_tone_notes: Buy-side memo voice. Confident, declarative, numerical. Treat the agent like a junior analyst that doesn't sleep. Avoid hype words like 'revolutionary' or 'game-changing'. Specifics over adjectives. The metric IS the headline.
do_rules: Lead each beat with a concrete number where possible
Use 'dexter' lowercased in headlines, the way the repo names it
Honor the editorial-90s preset's halation by writing copy that has a single hot word per scene
Keep the close as a thesis restatement, not a tagline
dont_rules: Don't mention the version string v2026.5.24 in scene copy (version numbers belong nowhere)
Don't repeat any specific number across the tweet, the Gmail Why-this-one, and the scene copy
Don't compare to Claude Code by name in scene text (the comparison goes in dossier and Gmail)
Don't use the framework MANIFESTO (matches yesterday's entry)
Don't use editorial-paper, gallery, claude, mono-terminal, subway-chrome, cctv, or geominimal aesthetics (each in the last 14 entries)
